title: GameComponent
description: The Lego connector contract for AI-assemblable game components.

sourceModule.description: Legacy single-target module reference. Superseded by implementations[].module, which can name one per target; kept while both shapes carry.

implementations.description: Per-target implementation status. Status is a property of a (brick, target) PAIR rather than of a brick, which the flat platform list cannot express — see fixtures 10 and 11 in the consuming application. Carried alongside platform during migration.

target.description: Runtime target. canvas2d, roblox, unity, godot, unreal.

status.description: running: works today. constructor-verified: adapter present and naming a verified source constructor. scaffold: adapter present, calls unverified. not-implemented: target intended, upstream module named, adapter unwritten. unmapped: nobody has attempted this target. external: implemented in a consuming repository and not verifiable from here.

provenance.description: upstream-mapped: existing source module; library-native: new design; hybrid: upstream-mapped module with explicit library contract extensions requiring adapter work.

eventIntents.description: Maps an event this component emits to the side-effect intent classes it carries (e.g. persist, notify). A sink declaring a matching sinkFor accepts the wire without enumerating the event in listensTo.

sinkFor.description: Side-effect intent classes this component accepts generically. A wire resolves by intent when the eventIntents of the emitter for that event intersect this list.
